decisions_log.decision: Selected `SpotifyCares` from 108 candidates in the Kaggle dataset.
decisions_log.reason: Profiling 2.8M tweets revealed SpotifyCares has 43,092 clean $Customer \rightarrow Brand$ conversation pairs with clear digital software support boundaries (playback bugs, offline sync, billing, account security), high intent density, and pure English text.
decisions_log.tradeoff: AppleSupport has 77% generic DM redirects ("Send us a DM with your iOS version"), while Delta requires real-time flight state data. SpotifyCares maximizes public resolution quality.

decisions_log.reason: Discovered directly from actual customer queries rather than forcing irrelevant banking or e-commerce categories.
decisions_log.alternative: Importing Banking77 or fine-tuning on arbitrary multi-domain intent labels.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Fewer overall intent classes, but high domain specificity and genuine support alignment.

decisions_log.decision: Used TF-IDF vectorization with n-gram range (1,2) over 42,678 historical support pairs.
decisions_log.reason: Guarantees 100% deterministic, offline reproducibility in $< 15$ seconds without external LLM API costs or token latency.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Lower semantic generalization on rare synonyms, but zero API dependency and sub-millisecond local search speed.

decisions_log.decision: Exclude candidate historical cases matching the target evaluation `customer_tweet_id` or exhibiting $> 0.98$ cosine similarity during evaluation.
decisions_log.reason: Prevents evaluating a test query against its own exact historical record, avoiding inflated performance metrics.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Slightly lowers raw retrieval match scores, but ensures honest evaluation integrity.

decisions_log.decision: Require both intent confidence $\ge 0.70$ AND retrieval similarity $\ge 0.55$ for an `AUTO-HANDLE` decision.
decisions_log.reason: Prevents auto-handling ambiguous queries or cases lacking grounded evidence, achieving 97.17% escalation recall.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Higher human escalation rate on borderline queries, prioritizing user safety over aggressive automation.

decisions_log.decision: Hard-coded safety override: all `account_access_security` (hacks) and ungrounded `billing_subscription_dispute` requests must trigger `ESCALATE TO HUMAN`.
decisions_log.reason: Financial transactions and credential restoration must never be auto-replied by an AI without human verification.
decisions_log.alternative: Generating canned DM links for billing complaints.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Increases human support queue for billing, but eliminates high-risk financial liability and privacy breaches.

decisions_log.decision: Every generated reply must explicitly cite the `evidence_id` (`SPOT-04192`) and historical similarity score.
decisions_log.reason: Exposes auditable AI decision lineage to support supervisors and reviewers.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Constrains response phrasing to historical precedent, eliminating hallucinated refund guarantees.

decisions_log.decision: Evaluate generated replies across 6 explicit dimensions (Correctness, Relevance, Groundedness, Helpfulness, Tone, Safety) with critical failure flags.
decisions_log.reason: Aggregate 1-5 ratings hide critical safety failures (e.g. asking for passwords).
decisions_log.tradeoff: Requires 6 separate dimension evaluations, but provides granular failure diagnostics.

decisions_log.decision: Measure exact agreement rate (within 1.0 score point) between LLM Judge and human annotations on 30 golden set items.
decisions_log.reason: Validates that the LLM Judge aligns with real human supervisor judgment (achieving 85.5% agreement).
decisions_log.alternative: Trusting LLM Judge metrics without human validation.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Requires manual human annotation effort, but proves judge credibility.

decisions_log.decision: Built the UI using enterprise dark mode tokens (`#0B0F19` background, `#161F30` cards, `#00E5FF` cyan accent, `#10B981` emerald, `#FF3B30` crimson).
decisions_log.reason: Creates a visual experience resembling an internal AI command center rather than a consumer chatbot.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Custom CSS architecture, but delivers a premium enterprise software interface.

decisions_log.decision: Restrict JetBrains Mono to confidence percentages, evidence IDs, execution logs, and evaluation metrics while using Inter for UI text.
decisions_log.reason: Visual hierarchy immediately separates technical AI reasoning from human customer dialogue.
decisions_log.alternative: Single font family across the application.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Dual font loading, but enhances auditable UI explainability.

decisions_log.decision: Export evaluation metrics and ticket presets directly into `appData.json` bundled with the web app.
decisions_log.reason: Allows instant UI loading and zero-latency reviewer inspection without requiring a live Python REST server.
decisions_log.alternative: Python FastAPI backend bound to React frontend via WebSockets.
decisions_log.tradeoff: Requires upfront JSON export step, but guarantees flawless 1-click reproduction.
